dimensions.note: record logs structured entry and successful completion without lineage contents.
Canonical validation and replay checks fail before writes with actionable deterministic errors.
Synthetic tests cover complete/incomplete lineages, strictness, canonical rejection, identity/version replacement, SHA/predecessor tampering, chronology, freshness, and deterministic diagnostics.
Identity/version maps deterministically to one resource; existing state is read before write and replay/replacement fails closed.
No external API calls; producer provenance and digests are explicitly treated as claims, not authority.
No external handles or temporary resources.
Published examples and fixtures are generic and synthetic.
All public and nested objects are strict; hashes, versions, timestamps, order, canonical form, provenance chronology, and freshness are fail-closed.
The immutable lineage resource declares infinite lifetime and ten-version retention.
Append-only evidence persistence intentionally has no update/delete/sync authority or external lifecycle.
No external mutation occurs; replay state is checked in execute immediately before persistence.
The sole resource name is a deterministic lowercase SHA-256 of the lineage identity/version tuple.
Replay detection uses readResource rather than direct repository access.
Initial standalone publication; no registry predecessor exists.
